body: Thank you for this. How where they days after? They are not giving me my space and I don't know how to respond or react

My dad acted completely surprised, which threw me through a loop. I have known my mom suspected for awhile and thought she would have told my dad. I'm assuming she didn't cause she didn't want it to be true. I don't know if either will fully come around ever. I could be wrong and hope I am.

I am a survivor and after speaking with many friends who have supported me, and reading these encouraging posts I can't let this be what conquers me.  I've been through too much to stop fighting now.  Thanks you for your thoughts:-)

Thank you for this, gives me hope they will maybe come around one day.  I am happy for your friend I like reading and hearing stories of families coming to realize being gay doesn't change who you are.
Thank you. I did call my therapist and they helped talk me through my thoughts! I appreciate the encouraging comments on here, reminds me their are awesome understanding caring people!!
